lessons.topic_ruby: 自己紹介[じこしょうかい]
lessons.topic_en: Self-introduction: name, country, city, how you get around, job, birthday.

lessons.topic_ruby: 趣味[しゅみ]と 映画[えいが]
lessons.topic_en: Hobbies, what kind of movies you watch, and how often.
Invitations, clock times, and the past tense of verbs.
い- and な-adjectives, and describing a place.

lessons.topic_ruby: 形容詞[けいようし]の かこと 方位[ほうい]
lessons.topic_en: Past tense of adjectives, and compass directions.
Wanting a thing, and wanting to do something.
Verb groups, the te-form, and てください.

lessons.topic_ruby: どうぞ 食[た]べてください
lessons.topic_en: Offering food, drinks, a seat or a present with どうぞ Vてください; いただきます; declining with ちょっと…; て-form review.
